授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
This course is aimed to improve students' ability in
1. Understanding Earth and environmental science papers in English
2. Making science presentations in English
3. Discussing science in English.
English texts on 5 topics will be distributed and used for practicing these skills.
Students will be grouped into groups to work on various assignments like news report, text reading, presentation and discussions.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course is aimed to improve students' ability in
1. Understanding Earth and environmental research articles in English
2. Making science presentations in English
3. Discussing science in English.
English texts on 5 topics will be distributed and used for practicing these skills.
Students will be grouped into groups to work on various assignments like news report, text reading, presentation and discussions.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
1. Students must speak english in the course. If you cannot, please do not choose this course.
2. Students must do homeworks, which will need about 30 minutes to finish. Please do not choose this course if you have no time for homework.
1. Basic ability in discussion in English
2. Basic ability in reading simple science articles
3. Basic ability in making powerpoint presentation
